summary: The SCF model represents a report generation system in the HSPnet framework, handling report metadata and processing report requests with specific parameters.
purpose: To facilitate the structured generation of reports, including handling of program metadata and logos, using specified parameters.

workflows.name: GenerateReport_SCF.RunReport
steps: Parse input parameters for ProgramID, Logo, LogoWidth, and LogoHeight.
Check if Logo file exists; discard if not.
Initialize SCF report model with retrieved data.

business_rules: If Logo file does not exist on the system, it should not be used in the report.
conditions: If ProgramID is zero after parsing, return an error message.
system_behavior: Handles report generation by processing input parameters and executing the report through an external reporting engine.
